items.item_text: resume
cover letter
Current certification with one of the following NCCA accredited organizations: NASM-CPT, ACSM-CPT, NSCA-CPT, ISSA-CPT or ACE-CPT. (Required)
American Red Cross Adult and Pediatric CPR/AED/First Aid Certification. (Required)
High school diploma and / or equivalent certification / experience / training. (Required)
Previous experience with instruction of fitness and recreation programs.

The WorkStrong Personal Trainer provides instructional guidance and program activities related to health and fitness in an accredited environment. This position educates participants on fitness and health-related topics, conducts fitness assessments and personal training sessions, and designs and implements individual workout programs. The WorkStrong Personal Trainer coaches clients on the proper use of cardiovascular and strength equipment, promotes safe technique and form, and maintains detailed client records. Additionally, this position serves as a liaison between other Recreational Sports programs and ensures adherence to Rec Sports Community Agreements and activity guidelines.
Provides advanced or specialized activity instruction to program participants, individually or in groups.
Trainers provide sessions at the RSF, other campus locations, or virtually through live-streamed and on-demand content.
Trainers are expected to appropriately program/periodize the following types of training: strength, cardiovascular, flexibility, balance, speed/agility/quickness, plyometrics and core training.
Trainers will work with staff and faculty, and will need to program the correct modifications for their clients and appropriate progressions and regressions of exercises.
Trainers must be able to work in a busy environment and adapt workout routines from available equipment and resources.
Maintains a welcoming and supportive environment for program participants and facilitates participation.
Trainers conduct energizing, fun, safe sessions for all fitness levels and encourage and motivate their clients.
Answers questions from participants to support them in achieving their healthy living and wellness goals.
Builds effective, authentic relationships with clients and facilitates others to connect with one another.
Interacts clients in a positive and professional manner.

Responsible for ensuring that fitness spaces provide a safe environment including the condition and proper storage of all equipment used during training sessions. Instruct clients on correct equipment usage and body mechanics.
Updates availability in Mindbody or other scheduling software system.
Provide weekly availability for clients to schedule appointments.
Tracks client progress and personal administrative records (time keeping, internal communications, client records, etc).
Maintains required professional certifications, including American Red Cross or American Heart Association Adult and Pediatric CPR/AED/First Aid certification.
Stays current on teaching methods, techniques, and skills through continuing education and participates in required professional development activities.
Must be able to work effectively, across all organization levels, internally and externally.

Must have highly effective verbal and written communication skills in the English language, active listening, critical thinking, multitasking, time management skills, and dynamic flexibility in adapting to the needs of clients.
Knowledge of and/or ability to learn campus policies and procedures.
Service orientation, program management, sound judgment and decision-making, developing original ideas, creative problem-solving skills in a varied and challenging environment.
Basic skills in computer programs relevant to job duties.
Working knowledge of and/or ability to learn program activity practices and required procedures.
